6:09 LTE 87%

Reels

1/2 cup chicken stock
Salt and pepper

Method

1. Season the thighs with salt and pepper.

2. Sear skin side down for 7 minutes until golden.
3. Flip, add butter and garlic.

4. Pour in the stock and bake at 400F for 20 minute
5. Rest 5 minutes and spoon the sauce over.
